answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one voyage weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, an adversary who spins up 28 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 243 times the capital for one share. The bridge report shows the merge explicitly at each reef. A farm of 1498 identities would post 1402 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
